`enum DraggableProperty.DraggableType`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.node.property` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [DraggableProperty.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/node/property/DraggableProperty.java)

Whether a drag moves the node or a copy of it.

## Learn more

- [Drag and drop](/use/learn/interactivity/drag-and-drop/#leave-the-original-in-place)

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`MOVE`](#DraggableProperty-DraggableType-value-MOVE) | The node follows the mouse, then stays where it is dropped. |
| [`COPY`](#DraggableProperty-DraggableType-value-COPY) | A copy follows the mouse above the UI while the node stays in place; the copy disappears on drop. |

## Value details

<a id="DraggableProperty-DraggableType-value-MOVE"></a>

### MOVE

`MOVE` 

The node follows the mouse, then stays where it is dropped.

<a id="DraggableProperty-DraggableType-value-COPY"></a>

### COPY

`COPY` 

A copy follows the mouse above the UI while the node stays in place; the copy disappears on drop.
